instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: In context, pedestrians means...
questions.explanation: A pedestrian is a person travelling on foot, usually along a street.
questions.explanation_ar: pedestrian تعني شخصاً يسير على قدميه، عادة في الشارع.

questions.question: In context, a concept is...
options: a general idea in the mind
a written rule in a book
options_en: a general idea in the mind
a written rule in a book
questions.explanation: A concept is an abstract idea formed in the mind rather than a physical thing.
questions.explanation_ar: concept فكرة مجردة تتشكل في الذهن، لا شيء مادي.

questions.question: In context, urban describes something...
questions.explanation: Urban means connected with a town or city, and its opposite is rural.
questions.explanation_ar: urban تعني متعلق بالمدينة، وعكسها rural الريف.

questions.question: In context, an individual is...
questions.explanation: An individual is one person considered separately from the group.
questions.explanation_ar: individual هو شخص واحد يُنظر إليه منفصلاً عن الجماعة.

questions.question: In the sentence 'shoppers focus on the display', focus means...
questions.explanation: Here focus is a verb meaning to direct attention closely onto something.
questions.explanation_ar: focus هنا فعل يعني توجيه الانتباه بقوة إلى شيء ما.

questions.question: In context, a promoted product has been...
questions.explanation: Promote means to advertise or publicise something so that people notice it.
questions.explanation_ar: promote تعني الإعلان عن شيء أو الترويج له ليلاحظه الناس.

questions.question: A sophisticated shopper is someone...
options: eager to avoid all kinds of work
ready to accept every single claim
options_en: eager to avoid all kinds of work
ready to accept every single claim
questions.explanation: Sophisticated here means refined and able to grasp complicated ideas, not merely complicated.
questions.explanation_ar: sophisticated هنا تعني راقٍ في الفهم وقادر على إدراك الأفكار المعقدة.

questions.question: If a habit has evolved, it has...
questions.explanation: To evolve is to develop gradually from an earlier form into a new one.
questions.explanation_ar: to evolve يعني التطور التدريجي من شكل سابق إلى شكل جديد.

questions.question: If the writer alluded to a study, he...
questions.explanation: To allude to something is to refer to it indirectly without stating it plainly.
questions.explanation_ar: to allude to يعني الإشارة إلى شيء بشكل غير مباشر دون التصريح به.

questions.question: A shopper's priorities are...
questions.explanation: Priorities are the things ranked as most important at a given time.
questions.explanation_ar: priorities هي الأشياء المصنفة كأهم الأشياء في وقت معين.

questions.question: If a brand distinguishes itself, it...
questions.explanation: To distinguish yourself is to make yourself clearly different from others.
questions.explanation_ar: to distinguish يعني تمييز النفس بإظهار اختلاف واضح عن الآخرين.

questions.question: In context, to liberate shoppers means to...
questions.explanation: To liberate is to set free from a restriction or control.
questions.explanation_ar: to liberate يعني التحرير من قيد أو سيطرة.
